description: Master switch: when false, no movement, open or close deformation runs.
Deformation intensity; zero is undeformed.
Edge liquid colour (ARGB) for open and close; alpha zero draws no liquid.
Deform windows while they move. Does not enable or disable open or close.
Movement material; invalid names are rejected.
Liquid-only internal flow resistance; higher is thicker and more cohesive.
Liquid-only movement stiffness and recovery speed; higher snaps back faster.
Liquid-only movement inertia after a stop; zero lands without overshoot.
Liquid-only per-window and per-movement randomness; zero moves windows identically.
Wiggle movement has no options; this empty table is part of the layout and registers no setting.
Edge pop-out when a window opens; false opens without it. Movement is unaffected.
Open material; invalid names are rejected.
Edge the first window on a workspace pops out of; later windows use the side they appear on (see Edge choice).
Use monitor edges (screen) or edges inside reserved areas (work_area) for the pop-out.
Share of pop-out travel fed to the movement field as drag; zero is a rigid pop.
Open-only stiffness and recovery speed of the pop-out; higher snaps back faster.
Open-only inertia of the pop-out; zero lands without overshoot.
Edge drain when a window closes; false closes natively. Movement is unaffected.
Close material; invalid names are rejected.
Drain by side of appearance (auto), nearest valid edge, or opening edge (origin, falling back to auto).
Use monitor edges (screen) or edges inside reserved areas (work_area) for the drain.
Small edge-liquid splash where a closing window disappears; false closes without liquid.
Close-only stiffness and recovery speed of the drain; higher snaps back faster.
Close-only dive acceleration; higher advances the dive faster.
